title: fix(settings): translate the five Access policy field helps in every locale
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6v19uPsX6gX42G8tGcvvzb)_

Fixes #34121

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：系统设置 → 访问策略 页面上 5 个字段（允许的 IP 范围、闲置超时、会话最长有效期、每用户最大同时会话数、要求多因素认证）的说明文字，在全部 10 个非英文语言包里补上了译文；覆盖检查里暂记这 5 项的 `HELP_OWED` 名单清空。
- 为什么改：此前任何非英文界面下，这 5 个字段的说明都退回显示英文原文，管理员读不懂限制规则（比如“只能比部署更严”“0 表示沿用部署”）。
- 风险与回滚：只改翻译文本与一个测试名单，不动键名、标签、选项值或任何运行逻辑；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-settings/src/translations/zh-CN.ts`（`access_policy.keys` 下 5 条 `help`，核对语义是否与英文一致）；`settings-translation-coverage.test.ts`（`HELP_OWED` 清空、只减不增的检查仍在）；任一其他语种文件抽查。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/translations/settings-translation-coverage.test.ts`，预期 150 条全过；或切到中文界面打开 系统设置 → 访问策略，5 个字段下方应为中文说明。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/services/service-settings/src/translations/{zh-CN,zh-Hant,ja-JP,ko,de,es-ES,fr,pt-BR,ru,ar}.ts`: each locale's `settings.access_policy.keys` gains a `help` for `allowed_ip_ranges`, `session_idle_timeout_minutes`, `session_absolute_max_hours`, `max_concurrent_sessions_per_user` and `mfa_required`, written from the English manifest description of each key and using the terms the locale already uses on this page and on the `auth` twins (deployment, organization, member, session, grace period). The `mfa_required` help names the locale's own Off option label. zh-Hant is hand-written in this package (no generator owns these files), so it was written directly, in Traditional terms (工作階段, 登入, 驗證).
- `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts`: `HELP_OWED` is now `{}`. The shrink-only pin ("every owed help entry is a described field that some locale still leaves untranslated") stays in place, so any future entry is held to the same rule.
- `.changeset/34121-access-policy-field-helps.md`: `@objectstack/service-settings` patch (the locale files ship in `dist`).

No keys, labels, option values or runtime code change; `en.ts` is untouched (the English help is the manifest description, as for every other described field).

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings test` at head `3f97eb6433`: Test Files 76 passed (76), Tests 1516 passed (1516); `typecheck` clean (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- Ablation, one help removed: `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` renamed the zh-CN `mfa_required` `help` key (anchor 1 to 0, blob `cd502448eda1` to `d91b126ff083`); the coverage file went red with exactly one failure, `zh-CN missing for access_policy: key:mfa_required.help` (1 failed, 149 passed); restore verified by blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports the locale files from source (`./index.js`), so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

## Acceptance notes

- The zh-CN `access_policy` labels (outside this card's keys' `help`) still use half-width parentheses, for example `闲置超时(分钟)`; the full-width punctuation pin covers only `settings.auth`. Noted, not filed.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gate families (dispatch-gates, 64 commands)</summary>

Run on `0a8ebf8084` (the fix commit, before the one merge of `origin/main`): 63 exit 0; `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (reads every package's `dist`, and this worktree built only the service-settings closure), so NOT MEASURED locally; CI runs it. `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciliation: 64 derived, 63 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

</details>

<details><summary>After merging origin/main (`16d3abc41d`) into the branch</summary>

The merge touched no service-settings file; `packages/spec` moved (validation-message), so spec was rebuilt and the service-settings suite re-run on `3f97eb6433` (results above). `overlap-check`: merges cleanly with `origin/main` and with #34223, VERDICT clean.

</details>

The wide app-shell run and the full CI farm are left to CI.
